rules.check: const old = ctx.old || {}; const r2 = Object.assign({}, old, row); if (String(r2.status) === 'cancelled') return true; if (ctx.old && String(old.starts_at) === String(r2.starts_at) && String(old.ends_at) === String(r2.ends_at) && String(old.doctor_id) === String(r2.doctor_id) && String(old.status) !== 'cancelled') return true; const s = new Date(String(r2.starts_at)); const e = new Date(String(r2.ends_at)); if (isNaN(s.getTime()) || isNaN(e.getTime()) || e.getTime() <= s.getTime()) return 'Choose a valid start and end time.'; const sm = s.getUTCHours() * 60 + s.getUTCMinutes(); const em = e.getUTCHours() * 60 + e.getUTCMinutes(); if (s.toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== e.toISOString().slice(0, 10) || sm < 480 || em > 1080) return 'Appointments must fall within clinic hours (08:00-18:00).'; const q = await ctx.db.query('select appointment_id from slot where doctor_id = $1 and active = true and starts_at < $2::timestamptz and ends_at > $3::timestamptz and appointment_id is distinct from $4::uuid', [String(r2.doctor_id), e.toISOString(), s.toISOString(), ctx.old ? String(old.id) : null]); const rows = Array.isArray(q) ? q : ((q && q.rows) || []); if (rows.length > 0) return 'This doctor already has an appointment at that time.'; return true;

workflows.title: Reserve the doctor's slot when an appointment is booked

do.code: await ctx.db.create('slot', { appointment_id: String(row.id), doctor_id: String(row.doctor_id), starts_at: row.starts_at, ends_at: row.ends_at, active: true });

workflows.title: Keep the slot in step when an appointment moves or is cancelled

do.code: const all = await ctx.db.list('slot'); const s = all.find((x) => String(x.appointment_id) === String(row.id)); if (s) { await ctx.db.update('slot', String(s.id), { starts_at: row.starts_at, ends_at: row.ends_at, active: String(row.status) !== 'cancelled' }); }

workflows.title: Hourly: remind patients of appointments in the next 24 hours

do.code: const now = ctx.now().getTime(); const rows = await ctx.db.list('appointment'); let n = 0; for (const a of rows) { const t = new Date(String(a.starts_at)).getTime(); if (String(a.status) === 'booked' && !a.reminded && t > now && t - now <= 86400000) { const hh = new Date(t).toISOString(); await ctx.db.create('reminder', { appointment_id: String(a.id), patient_id: String(a.patient_id), message: 'Reminder: ' + String(a.reason) + ' with ' + String(a.doctor_name) + ' on ' + hh.slice(0, 10) + ' at ' + hh.slice(11, 16) + '.' }); await ctx.db.update('appointment', String(a.id), { reminded: true }); n++; } } ctx.log('reminders created: ' + n);
